body_lead: In a groundbreaking initiative, the Maharashtra State Excise Department has launched a powerful campaign to curb underage drinking in Mumbai, aimed at educating youth under 21 about the risks associated with alcohol consumption. The Maharashtra State Government has passed a resolution mandating that all licensed liquor outlets —including shops, bars, hotels, and permit rooms — install cameras equipped with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) capabilities.
